title: SparseDitto: Customizing GPU Kernels for Different Sparsity Patterns with LLM-Based Agentic System
abstract: arXiv:2608.05033v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sparse matrix kernels are fundamental to scientific computing, graph analytics, and machine learning. Their GPU performance depends strongly on the input sparsity pattern and execution strategy. For the same SpMM on the same matrix, cuSPARSE exhibits a 350x performance gap between CSR and Blocked-ELL. Our study of multiple data formats, specialized systems, and sparse compilers shows that no single implementation consistently dominates across sparsity patterns and operators. This motivates a system that can adapt its representation, execution strategy, and hardware mapping to each workload and target GPU.   We present SparseDitto, an LLM-based system that constructs a GPU kernel for each matrix, operator, and target GPU. SparseDitto supports SpMV, SpMM, and SpGEMM within a unified design framework. A lightweight additive model ranks established strategies using structural features of the input matrix. An architecture-aware plan

translated_title: SparseDitto：基于LLM代理系统为不同稀疏模式定制GPU内核
translated_abstract: 稀疏矩阵内核是科学计算、图分析和机器学习的基础。它们的GPU性能强烈依赖于输入稀疏模式和执行策略。对于同一矩阵上的相同SpMM操作，cuSPARSE在CSR和Blocked-ELL格式之间表现出350倍的性能差距。我们对多种数据格式、专用系统和稀疏编译器的研究表明，没有任何单一实现在稀疏模式和操作符上始终占优。这促使我们开发一个能够根据每个工作负载和目标GPU调整其表示、执行策略和硬件映射的系统。我们提出了SparseDitto，一个基于LLM的系统，为每个矩阵、操作符和目标GPU构建GPU内核。SparseDitto在统一设计框架内支持SpMV、SpMM和SpGEMM。一个轻量级加法模型使用输入矩阵的结构特征对既定策略进行排序。一个架构感知的计划...
tldr: SparseDitto利用LLM代理系统自动为不同稀疏模式和GPU架构定制内核，解决了现有方法在性能上无法统一最优的问题。
en_tdlr: SparseDitto leverages an LLM-based agentic system to automatically customize GPU kernels for diverse sparsity patterns and architectures, addressing the lack of a universally optimal implementation.
